0362__L12_Mas_76__34225A52.mp3.asr_text: Running out of time here! Head for that exit, on the double! We're gonna have to manually disable that rocket!
0362__L12_Mas_76__34225A52.mp3.translation: 没时间了！快去那个出口！得亲手把那枚火箭弄哑！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 没时间了！快去那个出口！得亲手把那枚火箭弄哑！

0363__L12_Mas_71__33DBE4CD.mp3.asr_text: Damn! We can't let them launch that other rocket!
0363__L12_Mas_71__33DBE4CD.mp3.translation: 妈的，不能让他们把另一枚火箭发射出去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 妈的，不能让他们把另一枚火箭发射出去！

0364__L12_Mas_0__3B17C299.mp3.asr_text: Battalion HQ reports no enemy activity on the north bank, but what's left beyond that is anyone's guess.
0364__L12_Mas_0__3B17C299.mp3.translation: 营部说北岸没有敌人活动，可再往前有什么，谁也说不准。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 营部说北岸没有敌人活动，可再往前有什么，谁也说不准。

0365__L12_Mas_1__3B25DA1A.mp3.asr_text: That's gonna be our job. We scout out the town, deal with any remaining enemy positions and report back to HQ.
0365__L12_Mas_1__3B25DA1A.mp3.translation: 所以轮到我们了。侦察镇子，清掉残余敌军阵地，再向营部报告。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 所以轮到我们了。侦察镇子，清掉残余敌军阵地，再向营部报告。

0366__L12_Tuc_2__1846C7FE.mp3.asr_text: Our artillery and air force boys have already pounded the hell out of that place!
0366__L12_Tuc_2__1846C7FE.mp3.translation: 咱们的炮兵和空军早把那儿炸翻天了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 咱们的炮兵和空军早把那儿炸翻天了！

0370__L12_Tuc_41__F40550ED.mp3.asr_text: No wonder Intel thought the area was clear. Those bastards have been dug in underground.
0370__L12_Tuc_41__F40550ED.mp3.translation: 难怪情报说这片没人。那些家伙全躲在地下。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 难怪情报说这片没人。那些家伙全躲在地下。

0371__L12_MA1_52__6872B992.mp3.asr_text: Battalion on the radio, Sarge. I got incoming artillery support.
0371__L12_MA1_52__6872B992.mp3.translation: 中士，营部来电，炮火支援就要到了。
0371__L12_MA1_52__6872B992.mp3.note: ASR的I got疑似we've got，按营部提供炮火支援理解。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，营部来电，炮火支援就要到了。

0372__L12_Mas_57__30C6C095.mp3.asr_text: Heads down, man! There's gonna be fireworks!
0372__L12_Mas_57__30C6C095.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，低头！要放烟花了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，低头！要放烟花了！

0373__L12_Mas_77__343071D3.mp3.asr_text: Gibson, we only have one shot at this, so make it a good one! Get a charge on that rocket! We've got your back! Now go!
0373__L12_Mas_77__343071D3.mp3.translation: 吉布森，我们只有这一次机会，别失手！去给那枚火箭装炸药，我们掩护你！快去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 吉布森，我们只有这一次机会，别失手！去给那枚火箭装炸药，我们掩护你！快去！

0375__L12_Mas_13__29BB0015.mp3.asr_text: I want everyone off the bridge! Head for those buildings!
0375__L12_Mas_13__29BB0015.mp3.translation: 所有人离开桥！到那些楼里去！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 所有人离开桥！到那些楼里去！

0377__L12_Mas_16__29E54698.mp3.asr_text: Goddamn Battalion Intel! Didn't they say this area was supposed to be clear?
0377__L12_Mas_16__29E54698.mp3.translation: 该死的营部情报！不是说这一带已经清干净了吗？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 该死的营部情报！不是说这一带已经清干净了吗？

0378__L12_Mas_54__309C7A12.mp3.asr_text: That's why they're hellbent on defending this ground!
0378__L12_Mas_54__309C7A12.mp3.translation: 难怪他们死也要守住这地方！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 难怪他们死也要守住这地方！

0379__L12_Mas_60__3218F4AD.mp3.asr_text: Artillery supports clear the way! Head out before the Krauts have time to recover!
0379__L12_Mas_60__3218F4AD.mp3.translation: 炮火把路清出来了！趁敌人还没缓过来，出发！
0379__L12_Mas_60__3218F4AD.mp3.note: supports clear疑似support has cleared，按炮火已清出道路理解。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 炮火把路清出来了！趁敌人还没缓过来，出发！

0380__L12_Mas_68__3289B0B5.mp3.asr_text: Ah, hell. Crowd talk ain't my strong point, but it sounds like they're about to launch some kind of rocket.
0380__L12_Mas_68__3289B0B5.mp3.translation: 干，我不太懂德语，不过听着像是要发射什么火箭。
0380__L12_Mas_68__3289B0B5.mp3.note: Crowd talk疑似Kraut talk，按德语修正，保留角色未能完全听懂的语气。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干，我不太懂德语，不过听着像是要发射什么火箭。

0381__L12_Mas_25__2B8C07B6.mp3.asr_text: Gibson, get up there and use that MG!
0381__L12_Mas_25__2B8C07B6.mp3.translation: 吉布森，上去用那挺机枪！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 吉布森，上去用那挺机枪！

0382__L12_MA1_75__6C06B153.mp3.asr_text: Sarge! Enemy out in the open!

0383__L12_MA1_43__66CBF874.mp3.asr_text: How far does this place go back?

0387__L12_Mas_55__30AA9193.mp3.asr_text: A V2! We must be near the launch site!
0387__L12_Mas_55__30AA9193.mp3.translation: 是V2！我们肯定就在发射场附近！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 是V2！我们肯定就在发射场附近！

0389__L12_Mas_79__344CA0D5.mp3.translation: 干得漂亮，吉布森！天晓得那玩意儿会打到哪，又能炸死咱们多少人。等营部知道这事，八成得给你申请枚勋章。“卢卡斯·吉布森列兵，杰出服役十字勋章”，听着来劲吧，大兵？
0389__L12_Mas_79__344CA0D5.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得漂亮，吉布森！天晓得那玩意儿会打到哪，又能炸死咱们多少人。等营部知道这事，八成得给你申请枚勋章。“卢卡斯·吉布森列兵，杰出服役十字勋章”，听着来劲吧，大兵？

0390__L12_Mas_70__33CDCD4C.mp3.asr_text: Don't let him escape! Get through those doors!
0390__L12_Mas_70__33CDCD4C.mp3.translation: 别让他们跑了！冲过那些门！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 别让他们跑了！冲过那些门！

0391__L12_Mas_31__2D088251.mp3.asr_text: LAY DOWN SMOKE COVER! WE'RE GONNA TAKE THAT BUILDING!
0391__L12_Mas_31__2D088251.mp3.translation: 放烟雾掩护！我们要拿下那栋楼！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 放烟雾掩护！我们要拿下那栋楼！

0394__L12_MA1_29__63B6D43C.mp3.asr_text: They can't all be coming from inside the house.
0394__L12_MA1_29__63B6D43C.mp3.translation: 不可能全是从那栋房子里出来的。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 不可能全是从那栋房子里出来的。

0395__L12_MA1_11__61913F95.mp3.note: ANIME疑似Enemy，按右侧敌情口令修正。

0396__L12_MA2_51__D045CEF0.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant Mason, German troop convoy heading this way!
0396__L12_MA2_51__D045CEF0.mp3.translation: 梅森中士，德军运兵车队正往这边来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 梅森中士，德军运兵车队正往这边来！
